description: Full-Stack Software Engineer and founder of NEXALPHA with 6+ years of experience and a Master's in Software Engineering and Image Processing. Passionate about AI, innovation, and sustainable agriculture. I'm developing NexAgri Rotate AI, a platform using NASA satellite data and 3D simulations to optimize crop rotation and water management. Seeking teammates skilled in agronomy, GIS, remote sensing, Python, AI, data science, and UI/UX. Let's turn space data into sustainable farming solutions!
summary:
NexAgri Rotate AI is an intelligent agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers adapt to climate change, optimize crop rotation, and manage water resources more sustainably.

Developed to address NASA’s “Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data” challenge, our platform combines NASA Earth observation data, artificial intelligence, geospatial analysis, and agricultural knowledge to transform complex scientific information into practical farming recommendations.

NexAgri integrates crop rotation simulations, satellite-based crop monitoring, irrigation planning, soil fertility assessment, and an agricultural digital twin. Using Google Cloud and Gemini AI, it also enables farmers to analyze plant diseases through photos and interact with an intelligent voice assistant in their local language, including Moroccan Darija.

Our solution is particularly important for Morocco and other regions facing water scarcity, soil degradation, and climate uncertainty. By making scientific data accessible to farmers, including those with limited technical knowledge, NexAgri aims to improve agricultural productivity, reduce resource consumption, strengthen food security, and promote climate-resilient farming.

Our vision is to bring space technology directly into farmers’ hands, turning satellite observations into smarter, more sustainable agricultural decisions.
details:
NexAgri Rotate AI — From Space Data to Smarter Farming

Project Overview

NexAgri Rotate AI is an intelligent agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers adapt to climate change, improve crop rotation, optimize water consumption, and make informed agricultural decisions.

Our project addresses NASA’s “Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data” challenge by transforming Earth observation data, climate information, artificial intelligence, and geospatial analysis into practical recommendations accessible to farmers.

The platform focuses particularly on Morocco, where agriculture faces increasing water scarcity, irregular rainfall, soil degradation, and climate uncertainty. However, its architecture is designed to support agricultural communities worldwide.

How Does NexAgri Work?

Farmers can create an account, register their farms, and draw agricultural plots on an interactive map. Each plot can be associated with crop information, soil characteristics, irrigation methods, historical agricultural activities, and geographical coordinates.

NexAgri combines these inputs with environmental and satellite data to support agricultural decision-making through eight complementary modules:

  • NexAgri Rotate AI: Recommends crop rotation strategies and allows farmers to compare agricultural scenarios based on climate, soil fertility, water requirements, and crop history.
  • NexAgri Aqua: Supports irrigation planning and water resource management.
  • NexAgri Monitor: Provides satellite-based vegetation monitoring and environmental indicators.
  • NexAgri Market Balance: Analyzes agricultural production intentions to help identify potential supply imbalances and overproduction risks.
  • NexAgri Digital Twin: Provides an interactive geographical representation of agricultural land and supports scenario visualization.
  • NexAgri Voice: Enables farmers to communicate with an intelligent agricultural assistant through natural-language and voice interactions.
  • NexAgri IoT: Provides an architecture for integrating connected agricultural sensors and real-time environmental measurements.
  • NexAgri CropProtect: Uses multimodal artificial intelligence to analyze plant images, identify possible symptoms of diseases or nutritional deficiencies, and suggest further investigations.

The platform also includes farm management, agricultural calendars, soil fertility assessment, and financial monitoring.

Integration of NASA Earth Observation Data

NASA Earth science resources are central to NexAgri’s scientific approach. Our data architecture is designed to integrate the following resources:

  • NASA POWER: Agroclimatology data, including temperature, precipitation, solar radiation, and other meteorological parameters.
  • Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS): Satellite observations for vegetation monitoring and crop development assessment.
  • NASA SMAP: Regional soil moisture observations and drought assessment.
  • NASA GPM IMERG: Precipitation estimates for rainfall analysis and irrigation planning.
  • NASA ECOSTRESS: Land surface temperature, evapotranspiration, and vegetation water stress analysis.
  • NASA SRTM: Elevation data for terrain modeling, slope analysis, and agricultural digital twins.

These datasets support a scientific framework for evaluating agricultural conditions and comparing adaptation strategies.

NexAgri considers the spatial resolution, observation dates, availability, and limitations of satellite datasets. Regional satellite measurements are not treated as precise measurements of individual farms without appropriate validation.

Technologies and Tools

NexAgri is built using a modern, scalable architecture combining web development, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and geospatial technologies.

Application development:

  • Next.js, React, and TypeScript for the web application.
  • Tailwind CSS for responsive and accessible user interfaces.
  • MapLibre GL JS and geospatial visualization tools for interactive agricultural mapping.
  • PostgreSQL and PostGIS for agricultural data management, spatial queries, and geographical calculations.

Google Cloud infrastructure:

  • Firebase App Hosting for application deployment.
  • Firebase Authentication for secure user authentication.
  • Google Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL database management.
  • Google Cloud Storage for agricultural images, documents, and scientific files.
  • Secret Manager for secure credential management.

Artificial intelligence and communication:

  • Google Vertex AI and Gemini for intelligent agricultural assistance and multimodal image analysis.
  • Google Cloud Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech for voice-based interactions.
  • OpenAI ChatGPT and Codex for software development assistance, debugging, documentation, and interface design.

Scientific and future hardware integration:

  • Python-based scientific processing and Cloud Run services for advanced agricultural and satellite-data analysis.
  • ESP32-based connected sensors for optional soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and irrigation monitoring.

The project is designed to operate without requiring farmers to purchase additional hardware. Connected sensors provide an optional enhancement rather than a mandatory requirement.

What Makes NexAgri Creative and Innovative?

NexAgri goes beyond traditional agricultural monitoring platforms by combining satellite observations, crop rotation recommendations, water management, market intelligence, plant image analysis, and natural-language assistance in a single ecosystem.

One of its key innovations is accessibility. Farmers can interact with the platform through a mobile-friendly interface and receive explanations in their preferred language, including Moroccan Darija.

Instead of presenting complex satellite images or scientific indicators without explanation, NexAgri aims to translate these observations into understandable agricultural guidance.

Another innovative feature is the agricultural digital twin, which enables farmers to visualize their land, explore environmental conditions, and compare alternative farming scenarios before making decisions.

NexAgri Market Balance also introduces a collective agricultural perspective by helping farmers understand potential production imbalances. For example, if many farmers intend to cultivate the same crop, the platform can highlight the potential risk of oversupply and encourage consideration of alternative crops.

Factors Considered During Development

Our team considered several important factors:

  • Water scarcity and increasing climate variability in Morocco.
  • Differences between rainfed and irrigated agriculture.
  • Soil fertility, crop diversity, and sustainable crop rotation.
  • The availability, resolution, and reliability of satellite observations.
  • The needs of smallholder farmers with limited financial and technological resources.
  • Mobile accessibility, multilingual communication, and varying levels of digital literacy.
  • Limited internet connectivity and the importance of offline-friendly features.
  • Data privacy, secure authentication, and protection of agricultural information.
  • The cost of cloud infrastructure and the scalability of the platform.
  • The uncertainty of scientific models and AI-generated recommendations.

Artificial intelligence is intended to support farmers, not replace their expertise or professional agronomic advice. Plant image analysis provides possible explanations rather than definitive diagnoses, and scientific recommendations should remain traceable to their underlying data sources.

Benefits and Intended Impact

NexAgri aims to help farmers:

  • Reduce unnecessary irrigation and improve water-use efficiency.
  • Improve crop rotation and preserve long-term soil fertility.
  • Identify potential vegetation stress and agricultural risks earlier.
  • Adapt agricultural planning to changing environmental conditions.
  • Make more informed crop selection and production decisions.
  • Improve farm productivity and economic resilience.
  • Access scientific knowledge through simple, multilingual interfaces.

The broader objective is to support sustainable agriculture, strengthen food security, and make space-derived scientific information accessible to communities that can benefit from it most.

Our long-term vision is to create an agricultural intelligence ecosystem where NASA Earth observation data, artificial intelligence, and local farming knowledge work together to build a more resilient and sustainable agricultural future.

NexAgri Rotate AI — Bringing space intelligence directly into farmers’ hands.
